criteria.text: Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.5 is stated as $9,000,000 but 12% of the $60,000,000 Purchase Price is $7,200,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 5 October 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 5 October 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (12% x $60,000,000 = $7,200,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $9,000,000.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (5 October 2027; 5 October 2032) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 14 July 2026 (448 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
